title: Pirate Freeports
subheader: Maritime syndicates and oathbound corsair havens
description:
![Pirate fleet anchored in a lantern-lit cove](images/pirate-cove-fleet.jpg)

## Overview

Pirate freeports rise where tidal coves meet hidden sea tunnels, governed by compact councils of captains, quartermasters, and dockwardens. They regulate salvage rights, divide spoils through sealed ledgers, and provide sanctuary to crews who honor the Saltwind charter.

## Governance and Codes

The Saltwind confederacy convenes each equinox beneath the black-beacon lighthouse. Decisions require a three-helm vote, balancing captains, navigators, and stevedores. Oathmarks inked on wrists record allegiances and are renewed annually during the Tidefire ceremony.

## Trade and Logistics

Freeports thrive on clandestine commerce: reef pilots guide contraband through shoals, while cooperative chandlers outfit ships with stormglass compasses and alchemical pitch. A standardized tally system prevents feuds by auditing cargo swaps in public taverns.

## Fleet Doctrine

Corsair wings favor fast skimmers with collapsible masts, striking in synchronized sweeps that disable sails before boarding. Veteran crews train with signal drums and mirrored pennants, allowing coordinated attacks across fog banks and moonlit bays.
